scenes.story_beat: A monolithic obsidian glass perfume bottle floats weightlessly as molten rose-gold mercury swirls around its facets through drifting amber volumetric vapor in a dark void with enigmatic poise.
Microscopic fragrance vapor droplets burst outward from the chrome atomizer nozzle through dark volumetric mist under intense backlit anamorphic violet laser light with tactile intensity.

A heavy diamond-cut magnetic cap snaps decisively down onto the obsidian bottle neck while golden specular highlights illuminate the glowing typography within a pristine studio void with premium authority.
